verdict.rationale: A sandbox platform for AI agents could plausibly let users plug MCP servers into its sandboxes, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP servers or MCP client support. Running third-party agents such as Claude Code inside sandboxes, or connecting LLMs through their own tool-use features, describes host capabilities of other products rather than E2B's own MCP integration, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
